caption: Mürren, Mürren
composition: Mürren cliff shelf looking across the valley to the Eiger north face · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Mürren stands on a narrow cliff shelf, wooden chalets and a church looking across the deep valley to the Eiger’s dark north face. The village is car-free, and the path along the edge is empty of prominent people. Late-September grass is green to tawny, and the village is not under winter snow. The Open-Meteo model is overcast, so cloud sits on the upper wall while the face stays identifiable.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of Mürren on its cliff with the Eiger north face across the valley
